title: No mercy; Helenus intervenes
intro: Agamemnon rejects ransom. Nestor presses the attack; Helenus proposes a defence and an appeal to Athena.

notes.text: πείθω, persuade: 3sg impf, “was persuading / sought to persuade”; τῷ possessive dat, his heart.
μέλλω + fut inf, was about to hand him over; δίδωμι fut inf δώσειν. κατάγω fut inf κατάξειν, epic -έμεν: “to lead down.”
“To his own attendant”; ὅς possessive adjective, dat sg; θεράπων dat sg.
θέω, run: pres ptc; ὁμοκλέω, shout at / rebuke: aor ptc; αὐδάω, speak: 3sg impf.
πέπων, gentle / soft-hearted: voc sg, reproach here. κήδομαι, care for: uncontracted 2sg pres mid + gen ἀνδρῶν.
Indignant question, “why indeed…?”; not a choice between alternatives.
ποιέω, 3sg perf pass, impersonal; πρός + gen, by. Sarcastic: “Have the Trojans treated you splendidly at home?”
ὑπεκφεύγω, escape: 3sg 2aor opt, negative wish; αἰπὺν ὄλεθρον, utter / sheer destruction.
“Not even [the child] whom a mother may carry”; φέρω 3sg pres opt, indefinite relative. γαστέρι, in the womb.
ὅς demonstrative, “not even he”; φεύγω 3sg 2aor opt, wish continued.
ἐξαπόλλυμι, perish utterly: 3pl 2aor mid opt, epic -οίατο = -οιντο.
Unmourned / without funeral care; vanished / leaving no trace. Agamemnon demands total annihilation.
ἀδελφειός = ἀδελφός, brother; φρήν, mind: acc pl.
αἴσιμος, fitting / proper: acc neut pl used adverbially; παρεῖπον aor ptc, counsel. The narrator calls the advice fitting; the moral force is troubling.
ἕθεν = ἑοῦ, himself; ὠθέω, push: 3sg aor mid.
κρείων, lord; οὐτάω, stab: epic 3sg aor; λαπάρη, flank: acc sg.
ἀνατρέπω, overturn: 3sg 2aor mid, “fell backward.”
λάξ, with the foot; βαίνω root aor ptc, planting his foot; ἐκσπάω, pull out: 3sg aor.
Of ash wood; with ἔγχος, spear, not “honeyed.”
κέλομαι, call to: reduplicated 3sg 2aor mid; ἀΰω, shout: aor ptc; μακρόν adv., loudly.
ἔναρα, spoils: gen pl; ἐπιβάλλομαι, reach for / set one's mind on: pres mid ptc + gen.
μετόπισθε, behind; μίμνω = μένω, stay: 3sg pres imperative, negated by μή τις.
Purpose, “so that he may reach [the ships] with the most”; ἱκνέομαι, 3sg aor mid subj.
κτείνω pres subj 1pl, exhortation, “let us kill”; ἕκηλος, at ease / unhurried, later for stripping armour.
ἂμ = ἀνά before π; “across the plain.” συλάω, strip: 2pl fut act; double acc, dead men and their gear.
θνῄσκω, die: perf act ptc acc pl; “dead,” not a present dying process.
εἰσαναβαίνω, go up into: 3pl root aor + κεν; unreal past, “would have retreated into Troy, had not…”
ἀναλκείη, lack of strength / cowardice: dat pl; δάμνημι 2aor pass ptc nom pl, overcome by weakness.
παρίστημι root aor ptc, standing beside; οἰωνοπόλος, bird-diviner: gen pl. ὄχα strengthens ἄριστος.
πόνος, battle's burden; ὔμμι = ὑμῖν; ἐγκλίνω perf pass 3sg, “rests upon you.” οὕνεκα, because; sentence continues.
